two_factor.title: Two-step verification
two_factor.required: A company you belong to requires two-step verification. Set it up to continue.
two_factor.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
two_factor.qr_label: QR code that adds this account to an authenticator app
two_factor.secret_label: Cannot scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
two_factor.recovery_intro: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your device. They will not be shown again.
two_factor.enabled: Two-step verification is on for this account.
two_factor.regenerate_intro: Used or lost your recovery codes? Enter a code from your authenticator app to get a new set; the old codes stop working. Lost the app? Sign in with a recovery code or a passkey, then replace the app below with another.
two_factor.app_intro: Add an authenticator app as another way to verify, for when your passkey is not at hand.
two_factor.app_remove_message: The codes it shows will no longer be accepted. To use one again, you will set it up again.
two_factor.app_remove_required: Two-step verification is required for your account, so the app cannot be removed, only replaced with another through “Replace the app”.
two_factor.passkeys_intro: A passkey confirms it is you with your fingerprint, face or device PIN, instead of a code.
two_factor.passkeys_elsewhere: This installation’s passkeys work only on the computer it is installed on, at {{address}}: open it there to add or use one.
two_factor.passkey_name_hint: So you can tell your devices apart, for example Work laptop.
two_factor.passkey_remove_message: “{{name}}” will no longer sign you in. To use it again, you will add it again.
two_factor.passkey_recovery: Get new recovery codes with a passkey
two_factor.replace_intro: Scan this code with the new app. The old one keeps working until you confirm with a code from the new one; your recovery codes are then replaced and your other sessions signed out.

passkey_sign_in.title: Sign-in with a passkey alone
passkey_sign_in.intro: Your passkey is then enough to sign in, with no password and no code. The password followed by a code still works.
passkey_sign_in.on_done: Sign-in with a passkey alone switched on.
passkey_sign_in.off_done: Sign-in with a passkey alone switched off.
passkey_sign_in.needs: It first takes an authenticator app and a passkey on this account.
passkey_sign_in.idle: It is not in use for now: it takes an authenticator app, a passkey and this installation's consent.

refused.passkey_sign_in_off: This installation does not allow sign-in with a passkey alone.
refused.passkey_sign_in_needs_passkey: Add a passkey the browser offers on its own first: this account's do not.
